paragraphs.text: DeepSeek Harness plugin: build pages with Meta's Astryx design system
# dsh-astryx-studio
English | 中文
A DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) plugin that lets the agent build pages with Meta's Astryx design system:
structured Astryx tools, a verify hook on every write, and a live preview tab in the right Sidebar.
> **How this differs from markmini1234/astryx:** that project restyles the dsh UI with Astryx. This
plugin does the tools, verification and preview for pages you build with Astryx. It does not theme d
gin does the tools, verification and preview for pages you build with Astryx. It does not theme dsh.
**Status: Day 3.** Tools, verify hook, prompt section, skill, the live preview tab and the template
gallery all work. Not published yet; the bench is deferred.
## What it does
| Tool | Wraps | Notes |
| `astryx_build(keywords)` | `build()` | English keywords. When the ranker has no evidence (`basis:
fallback` or no results) the result lists every page template so the model picks; `blank` is the las

t resort. |
| `astryx_template(id, path?)` | `template()` | Default path `src/pages/main/page.tsx`.
If the session folder is not an Astryx project, asks (DSH approval), then creates `./astryx-app` sha
ped like the official `apps/example-vite` and installs it. Runs the template's `installCommand` when

packages are missing; warms tsc in the background. |
| `astryx_component(name)` | `component(--dens

e --zh)` | Props before editing a component. |
| `astryx_search(query, type?, limit?)` | `search()`

| |
| `astryx_render(file, out?)` | `render()` (experimental) | Single-file HTML export. |
**Verify hook.** For `write` / `edit` / `apply_patch` / `str_replace_editor` on `.ts/.tsx` inside th
r `write` / `edit` / `apply_patch` / `str_replace_editor` on `.ts/.tsx` inside the Astryx workspace:
- **Synchronous** (milliseconds, returned with the tool result as `astryx verify ✗`): an esbuild syn
tax check and a lint count-diff. A write may not increase the number of `<div>`, `style={{}}` or `st
ylex.create`, and may not add an import outside `@astryxdesign/*`, `@stylexjs/stylex`, `react`, `rea
ct-dom`, `@heroicons/react`, `lucide-react`, `recharts`. Calibrated to zero false positives on all 5

7 page templates of `@astryxdesign/cli` 0.7.11, see docs/lint-calibration.md.
- **Asynchronous**: `t
sc --noEmit --incremental`, one run per workspace at a time; a new write cancels the run in flight.
The newest result is injected at the agent's next step (`astryx verify ✓ (tsc 0.6s)` or the TS error
s); that step waits up to `tscStepWaitMs` (5 s) for a run still in flight, so a model that edits and
immediately finishes still gets the verdict. End-to-end evidence: docs/e2e-day1.md.
**Prompt and skill.** A stable prompt section (the playbook rules from `build()` plus the Chinese wo
rkflow), and an `astryx-page` skill with a template selection table and the full template list.
**Preview tab.** `astryx_template` opens the **Astryx 预览** tab in the right Sidebar:
[该节后续省略]
## Install (development)
Requires dsh `>=0.2.2-rc.1 <0.3.0`.
[代码示例省略，未执行]
Expected: the five `astryx_*` tools in the tool list. Ask for a page and the **Astryx 预览** tab opens
with the live preview.
## Layout
| Path | What |

| `src/index.ts` | Host half: registers tools, prompt section, skill and the verify hooks |
| `src/t

ools.ts`, `src/astryx.ts` | The five tools over `@astryxdesign/cli/api` |
| `src/workspace.ts` | Wor

kspace detection and the built-in Vite scaffold |
| `src/verify/` | esbuild syntax, lint count-diff,

tsc scheduler, hook core |
| `src/preview/` | `.astryx-studio/` harness, Vite server lifecycle, per

-session preview state and runtime-error gating |
| `src/rpc.ts`, `src/shared/` | Client ↔ Host RPC

(exact routes under `/api/astryx-studio/`) and the shared protocol |
| `client/preview-tab.tsx`, `cl

ient/store.ts` | Preview tab body, toolbar, footer, persisted toolbar state |
| `src/prompt.ts`, `sr
c/generated/catalog.json` | Prompt section and skill; catalog generated from the pinned CLI at build

time |
| `client/index.tsx` | Web client half: `astryx-preview` tab type and body |
| `scripts/buil

d.mjs` | tsdown build to `lib/index.js` (ESM) and `lib/client.js` (a ModuleLoader factory) |
| `cord

is.patch.yml` | Bundle layer that inserts the plugin row `astryx-studio` |
| `tests/` | Unit tests p
er tool and hook, lint calibration over 57 templates, client smoke test; `ASTRYX_E2E=1` runs a real
scaffold → template → tsc integration |
`lib/` is committed so local-checkout and git installs need no build step.
## Release-time assets
- `pnpm exec tsx scripts/gen-thumbs.ts`: regenerates `assets/thumbs/*.png` (57 × 480×300, about 1 Mi

B) with Playwright.
- `node scripts/gen-preview-svg.mjs`: regenerates `docs/preview.svg` and `docs/p

review.zh.svg` (Plugin Manager detail images, lettering outlined from Noto Sans CJK SC).
- `node scr
ipts/gen-catalog.mjs` (run by `pnpm run build`): the playbook rules and template catalog from the pi
catalog.mjs` (run by `pnpm run build`): the playbook rules and template catalog from the pinned CLI.
## Scripts
`pnpm run typecheck` · `pnpm run build` · `pnpm test` · `pnpm run check` (all three)
